text:
Type: white wall shelf board
Use: shelf for books, frames and decor once mounted on brackets; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: white foil-finished board with smooth edges
Colors: white
Shape: long flat rectangular plank with clean square edges, plain surface, slim profile, light and simple, mounts on separate brackets
Feel: clean, neutral, light, quiet
Goes with: white walls, any bracket style, light wood, black or chrome accents; minimalist, Scandinavian or modern rooms
